text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Most people have left the beach as the day draws to a close.
text_block_list.orig_text:
日も傾いて、
海辺にはほとんど人がいなくなっていた。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Hard to believe how busy it was this afternoon when you see it like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
昼間あれだけいた人が、
あっという間にいなくなっちまったな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Guess we're pretty much done for the day, huh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これであたしらの仕事も一段落、
だな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Good work, man.
text_block_list.orig_text: おつかれ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch for helping out.
You really did a great job today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は手伝ってくれてありがとよ。
……大活躍だったな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy to hear that and all,
but you ended up saving me as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言ってくれるとうれしいけどよ、
あたしも{0}に助けられちまったしな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Guess that makes you a full-fledged beachside officer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これならおまえももう、
一人前の海のお巡りさんだな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
One that still uses a swim ring, though.
Haha. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
泳ぐときは浮き輪、
だけどな。
ははっ♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, check it out.
The sea's starting to shine now that the sun's setting into it...
Wait a minute.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
見ろよ。
夕日が海に沈んで、
輝いてやが……
って。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Seems a bit too bright, doesn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
ちょっと輝きすぎじゃねぇか？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I get that we bumped into each other and all,
but do we really need to go home together as well?
text_block_list.orig_text:
偶然会ったからって、
なんで一緒に帰ることになってんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? \"Is that a bad thing?\"
I mean, not really.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ？
　ダメかって……
いや、
ダメとは言ってないけどよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: But we're not nearly that close, are we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしらって
そんな仲がいいわけじゃねぇだろ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
What's with the lonely expression all of a sudden?!
Fine, fine! Let's just hurry home!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで露骨に寂しそうな顔するんだよ！？
分かった分かった、
さっさと帰ろうぜ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind going home together,
but at times like this I'm never sure what to talk about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一緒に帰るのはいいんだけどよ、
こういうとき、
何を話していいか分かんねぇんだよな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: H-how're things going?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……さ、
最近どうだ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Man! That was total dad talk!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
あたしは父親か！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Actually...
How're things going with you and Yui?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういや、
優衣のやつとはどうなんだよ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
What do I mean? Well, uh, you know...
Actually, nah. I should keep quiet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何がって……
ほら、
なんつーか……
……いや、
いいや。
あんまあたしがどうこう言うのもな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Hm? What're you looking over at the river for?
choice_data_list: There's a cat being carried away by it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん？
　どうした、
川の方なんか見て？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんだって！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap. It's stuck in a cardboard box, too!
Hold my bag for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジかよ、
段ボールごと流されてやがる……！
ちょっと鞄持っててくれ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What am I gonna do?
Do you really gotta ask?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ？
　どうするんだって、
決まってんだろ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna save it!
text_block_list.orig_text: 助けるんだよっ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
There, there.
You okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よしよし、
大丈夫だったかー？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Whoa there! Settle down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい、
暴れんなって！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh well.
Proof that it's still nice and energetic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
これだけ元気なら大丈夫だろ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You'll lend me a towel to use?
Thanks. Pretty thoughtful, ain't ya?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　タオル、
貸してくれんのか？
気が利くじゃねぇか、
ありがとよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about me catching a cold.
I'm not that frail.
text_block_list.orig_text:
風邪ひいちゃうよって、
あたしはそんなヤワじゃねーよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hold up.
Now that I take a closer look, I'm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと待てよ？
　よく見たら、
あたし今……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Eeek?!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃっ……！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Y-you took a peek, didn't you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおおおまえ、
見やがったな！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You swear you didn't?
As if!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見てないって、
そんなわけねぇだろ！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You're looking at me right now, even!
Turn away already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っつーか
早く向こう向けよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Forget everything you saw!
Don't even think about it for a second!
text_block_list.orig_text:
忘れろ！
いいか、
絶対思い出すなよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh.
You really do keep throwing me for a loop.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく、
ほんとおまえといると調子が狂っちまう。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Which reminds me...
I let out a squeal just now, didn't I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういやさっき……
女の子みてぇな声出しちまった……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: I sure hope he didn't hear me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
聞こえて、
ねぇよな……？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: And there we have it. Welcome back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
おつかれさま。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: What is it with you and getting glimpses of Makoto in embarrassing situations?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとあんたは、
マコトちゃんの恥ずかしいところばかり目撃するわね？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I know you'll forget everything since this is kind of like a dream,
but still... you're a lucky guy. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは『夢』みたいなものだから、
すぐに忘れちゃうとはいえ……
役得ってやつね♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Kidding, kidding.
text_block_list.orig_text:
冗談よ、
冗談。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Makoto's instincts when it comes to helping people
are kind of similar to yours, aren't they?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトちゃんの誰かを助けるために突っ走っちゃうところ、
あんたに似てるかもね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Keep backing her up from here on out, too.
text_block_list.orig_text: これからも彼女をサポートしてあげなさいよ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Okay. See you around. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ、
ばいばーい♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Huh?
Why am I sleeping on the beachside?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……
あれ？
なんであたし、
砂浜に寝転んでんだ……？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
And {0}'s sleeping beside me...
Hey! Wake up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
横には{0}も寝てやがるし。
おい、
起きろよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I'm see-through?
Any more of that and I'll smack you awake.
text_block_list.orig_text:
透けてる？
何言ってんだ、
寝ぼけてんじゃねぇぞ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Guess it goes to show how exhausted we were, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがに疲れてたんだろうな。
こんなところで居眠りなんてよ。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Wolf lady!
text_block_list.orig_text: 狼のお姉さん！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Wolf lady!
text_block_list.orig_text: 狼のお姉ちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh hey, it's you two!
You seem fine now. That's great.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん？
　
お、
さっきの二人か！
元気そうだな、
よかったよかった。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Thanks so much for helping us today!
text_block_list.orig_text: 今日は助けてくれてありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text: ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
No prob.
Try not to make your folks worried, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう。
あんまり家族に心配かけんじゃねぇぞ？

text_block_list.name: Boy & Girl
text_block_list.text: Okay! Bye-bye!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
　またね～！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Nah.
I was just thinking about how nice it is to help people, that's all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
人助けっていいもんだなって……
改めて、
思ったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Haha. Not like me to get all pensive and stuff.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ、
柄にもなくジーンときちまった。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Come on.
You're allowed to laugh at me about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだよ。
らしくないって、
笑ってくれていいんだぜ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You feel the same, huh?
Well then.
Now I'm extra glad I invited you along.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分もそう思う、
か。
そっかそっか。
なら、
{0}を今日誘ってよかったよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Mind if I... invite you again, then?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしよかったら、
だけどよ。
また……
誘ってもいいか？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: It'd be great to have you help out again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}のこと、
頼りにしてるぜ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Makoto flashed {0} a bright smile as the sun slowly set in the background.
text_block_list.orig_text:
沈む夕日に照らされながら、
マコトは{0}に微笑んでみせた。
